notes: In modern spoken Chinese, 闻 as a standalone verb only means 'to smell' (unlike 听 tīng, 'to listen/hear').
Its older meaning 'to hear' survives in common compound words like 新闻 (xīnwén, news) and 听说 / 耳闻.
